titulo: Rachida Dati in court: French ex-minister on trial over Renault-Nissan corruption case
cuerpo: Former minister and MEP Rachida Dati is on trial in Paris in the Renault-Nissan case, accused of corruption and influence peddling after taking €900,000 from a group subsidiary for counseling. Carlos Ghosn is being tried in the same case in absentia.
